embeds.title: ✨ Welcome to {server}!
embeds.description:
We're glad to have you here! Here is a quick guide to help you get started:

📜 **Rules & Guidelines**
Please read through {rules} to keep the community friendly and safe.

🎭 **Roles & Access**
Head to {roles} to pick up your roles and notification preferences.

📢 **Announcements**
Stay updated with our latest news and events in {announcements}.

💬 **Community Chat**
Say hello, introduce yourself, and start chatting in {general}!

🛠️ **Need Assistance?**
Reach out to our staff or open a ticket in {support}.
